message:
docs(test): 140 seconds is the heartbeat floor, not a hang

The retry suite takes around two and a half minutes and nothing about that
is visible from the outside. Every wait in it is bounded, but the waits are
real: the product floors the heartbeat interval at five seconds, so a test
cannot ask for a faster cycle and each HostAgent scenario sits through one.

Written at the top of the test and in the history entry because the obvious
response to a slow suite is to remove scenarios, and the scenarios are the
whole point -- what they assert is the number of requests, which is the only
thing separating "repaired it once" from "retried in a loop" and from
"signed out on the way to succeeding". The way to make it faster is to let
the interval be injected, the way the update tests inject their lock name.

Measured after a clean rebuild: 2m19s, 44 PASS, 0 FAIL.
